Three-tier LSM-style manager for VersionedDocument history.

detaileddescription.para: Implements the RocksDB philosophy for temporal data:
Write path: insert() → hot (MemTable) → [flush trigger] → warm (L0 blocks) → [compaction trigger] → cold (disk SST via TemporalColdStore)

Read path (getAsOf):
Hot tier: O(log h) — upper_bound on sorted map
Warm tier: O(b) — per-block: Bloom check → range check → scan
Cold tier: O(log N) — RAM index upper_bound + 1 disk read

sect2.title: Concurrency model
sect2.para:
Uses std::shared_mutex:
Reads (getAsOf, getHistory) hold shared lock → parallel readers.
Writes (insert, flush, compact) hold exclusive lock.
Background compaction thread acquires exclusive lock per key batch.

sect2.title: Usage
sect2.para: mgr.insert("orders", doc); auto v = mgr.getAsOf("orders", "k1", t);
Thread-safety: all public methods are thread-safe.
